description: Build a notification sound from your own layer design and get an editor link for it. The link opens the sound in the editor, where the user plays, tweaks and downloads it. Returns the link, the stored sound and warnings for any value that was out of range, rounded or ignored. Read get_sound_guide first.

duration.description: Note length. How long each note is held, shared by every layer and every repeat. Unit: s. Range 0.003 to 5, step 0.001, default 0.1.

effect.description: One effect over the whole sound.

amount.description: Amount. Effect mix. 0 is dry, 1 is fully wet. Unit: 0 to 1. Range 0 to 1, step 0.01, default 0.3.

type.description: Effect. One effect over the whole sound. Options: None: dry, no effect; Reverb: soft room, a gentle space; Chamber: big hall, long airy tail; Echo: repeats that fade away; Ping-Pong: echo that bounces left and right; Chorus: wider and shimmery; Phone: tiny speaker sound; Crunch: rough 8-bit edge.

layers.description: Layers play together, each from its own Start after. Leave out any field at its default. Up to 16 layers.

amAmount.description: Flutter. Tremolo depth: how far the level dips. Unit: 0 to 1. Range 0 to 1, step 0.01, default 0.

amRate.description: Flutter speed. Tremolo speed. Unit: Hz. Range 0.5 to 50, step 0.1, default 8.

attack.description: Attack. Time from silence to full level. Under 0.005 s gives a hard click at the start. Unit: s. Range 0.0005 to 1, step 0.0005, default 0.005.

decay.description: Decay. Time from full level down to the Hold level while the note is held. Unit: s. Range 0.003 to 2, step 0.001, default 0.3.

delay.description: Start after. When this layer starts, counted from the start of the sound. Spaces the notes of a melody. Unit: s. Range 0 to 5, step 0.01, default 0.

enabled.description: On. A layer that is off stays in the sound but is silent.

fmAmount.description: Wobble. Vibrato depth. 1 swings the pitch 4 semitones each way. Unit: 0 to 1. Range 0 to 1, step 0.01, default 0.

fmRate.description: Wobble speed. Vibrato speed. Unit: Hz. Range 0.5 to 50, step 0.1, default 6.

freq.description: Pitch. Note pitch. On a noise layer it is the centre of the hiss band. Unit: Hz. Range 40 to 4000, step 1, default 880.

gain.description: Level. Layer loudness. Unit: 0 to 1. Range 0 to 1, step 0.01, default 1.

noiseColor.description: Noise type. Noise colour. Options: White: bright, even hiss; Pink: softer, like wind; Brown: deep rumble. Noise layers only.

pan.description: Balance. Stereo position. -1 is left, 1 is right. Unit: -1 to 1. Range -1 to 1, step 0.01, default 0.

pitchSlide.description: Slide. Pitch glide over the Note length, up when positive, down when negative. Unit: semitones. Range -24 to 24, step 1, default 0.

randomNoise.description: Random. New noise on every play. Keep false. Noise layers only.

release.description: Ring out. Fade after the note ends. The main tail control. Unit: s. Range 0.003 to 5, step 0.001, default 0.4.

repeat.description: Times. How many times the layer plays its note. Unit: count. Range 1 to 5, step 1, default 1.

repeatGap.description: Gap. Silence between one repeat ending and the next starting. Unit: s. Range 0.02 to 1, step 0.01, default 0.1.

seed.description: Noise seed. Fixes the noise pattern so the sound is the same every play. Set one on every noise layer. Noise layers only.

sharpness.description: Sharpness. Width of the hiss band. Low is a wide hiss, high is close to a pitched whistle. Range 0.5 to 20, step 0.1, default 1.2. Noise layers only.

sustain.description: Hold. Level kept after Decay while the note is held. 0 is a struck or plucked note, 1 an organ-like note. Unit: 0 to 1. Range 0 to 1, step 0.01, default 0.

wave.description: Wave. Wave shape. Options: Sine: smooth and pure; Triangle: soft and woody; Saw: bright and buzzy; Square: sharp and electronic; Noise: hiss, wind and rumble.

name.description: Name. Sound name, up to 32 characters.

name: create_sound
title: Create a sound
